name: In Death: Siege Of Heaven
summary:
**Siege of Heaven** is an arcade-style stationary wave/gate-defense game mode built on the core archery mechanics of **In Death: Unchained**, now available as a standalone game. 

Whether you're new to VR or already love archery, this game gives you room to learn and have fun and has plenty of depth to keep you playing for years.

Got fifteen minutes for a quick round or two hours to climb the global ranks? **Siege of Heaven** rewards a sharp eye and a steady hand.

* **Pure Archery Mechanics**  No movement
